name: fablewright
description: Fable 5.1 writes the specification and accepts the result; pinned GPT-5.6, DeepSeek and GLM lanes perform it; a fresh cross-family reader returns one verdict. Routes are declared before the first delegation and every model pin is proven.

interface.shortDescription: Fable 5.1 writes the play; pinned lanes perform it; a fresh reader judges it.
interface.longDescription: FABLEWRIGHT keeps Claude Fable 5.1 as the wright: it owns intent, architecture, decomposition, the written specification, verification of everything returned, and final acceptance. Before the first task tool call it posts a machine-auditable CALL SHEET declaring one of solo, delegate, audit, full, or ensemble. Solo is the default and delegation must pay for its own specification. Cast lanes are pinned profiles - GPT-5.6 Luna at max for routine work, GPT-5.6 Terra at xhigh for judgment-heavy work, DeepSeek V4 Flash for high-throughput mechanical transformation, GLM-4.6 for independent cross-family implementation. A fresh read-only reader returns exactly ship, fix-first, or rethink, and must come from a different model family than the author or the review is recorded as same-family residual risk. Every model pin is verified against runtime evidence after the fact: a substituted model, effort, provider, or sandbox stops the lane instead of returning unverified work as if it had been routed correctly.
defaultPrompt: Use $fablewright:fablewright to post a call sheet before any task tool, then build and verify this.
Default to solo; select delegate, audit, full, or ensemble only when the stated risk earns it.
